## Flag Breakdown

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `-l` / `--list` | Lists all loaded modules |
| `--verbose` | Enables verbose output (shows module paths, memory addresses, load timestamps, and dependency chains) |

## Example Output

```
# p7c -l --verbose coding-zenka
[INFO] === Module List ===
[INFO] Module: core-engine
[INFO]   Path: /usr/lib/modules/core-engine.so
[INFO]   Address: 0x7f8a3c000000
[INFO]   Loaded: 2024-01-15T08:23:45Z
[INFO]   Dependencies: [stdlib, logging, config]

[INFO] Module: data-parser
[INFO]   Path: /usr/lib/modules/data-parser.so
[INFO]   Address: 0x7f8a3d000000
[INFO]   Loaded: 2024-01-15T08:24:12Z
[INFO]   Dependencies: [core-engine, json-utils]
```

The `--verbose` flag expands the basic list into a detailed inspection report, useful for debugging module conflicts or tracing initialization order.
